title: Eggplant Rolls with Three Cheeses in Tomato Sauce
subtitle: baked in a fresh chilli tomato sauce
description: Roasted eggplant slices rolled around a feta, mozzarella, ricotta and sour cream filling, then baked slowly in a fresh grated tomato sauce with basil and chilli.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C, line a baking tray with baking paper and brush it with olive oil.

Lay the eggplant slices (cut lengthways about 3 mm thick) on the tray and brush with olive oil. Bake for 15 minutes until browned, flip and bake another 15 minutes. Remove and cool for about 10 minutes.
Mix the three cheeses and sour cream in a bowl until uniform.
In another bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients: coarsely grated tomatoes, sliced garlic, basil, chopped chillies, salt and pepper.
Place a teaspoon of the cheese mixture at the end of each eggplant slice and roll up. Repeat with the remaining slices and filling.
Arrange the rolls in a casserole dish and pour the sauce over. Cover and bake for about 2 hours. Remove the lid, raise the oven to 220°C and bake for about 15 minutes until browned.
